pre_tail_comparison.comparison: Raw actor pose/vectors, virtual-base state, measured steering and requested/reported controls; absolute frames/timestamps excluded.

scope.intervals: Phase assigned by endpoint; all crossing intervals retained.100ms global offsets integrate both native50ms subintervals.
scope.tail_window: Tail-phase observations within the final10 observed seconds; no earlier-phase substitution. Signed vector and scalar-speed integrals are different quantities.
scope.native_sample_speed: Phase speed statistics use all native20Hz samples, not decimated100ms endpoints.
scope.route_cte: Worker-recorded route projection checked against fixed operational bound; not independently reprojected by this offline summary.
scope.camera_anchors: First even native tick at/after first tail observation; final even tick at/before expected final native tick. Never substitute an earlier available bundle. Trace ends at the same camera tick.
scope.interpretation: Descriptive coast/brake comparison only; sampled velocity signs do not prove substep backtracking or a physical/numerical cause. No actuator-timing or noise/gate conclusions.
